encryption.description: Upgrade environment variable encryption to SSE-KMS. Set to "kms" to enable. Incurs KMS API call cost. Required by HIPAA, PCI-DSS, FedRAMP. Supply kmsKeyArn via hatch["lambda"].

environment.description: Environment variables available to the function at runtime. Supports plain strings and Pulumi outputs.

handler.description: Where the function's code is, relative to the project root, in the usual Lambda form. Node: <file without extension>.<export>, e.g. "functions/api/index.handler" for `export const handler` in functions/api/index.ts; omit to deploy a blank placeholder. Rust (required): a Cargo package directory or a .rs file, e.g. "functions/api".

logRetention.description: CloudWatch log group retention period. Default: "1y" (satisfies SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS baseline).

memory.description: Memory in MB. Valid: 128 to 32768 in 1MB increments. Default: 1024.

permissions.description: Inline IAM permissions added to the execution role. Use for ad-hoc access not covered by the grant system.

runtime.description: The Lambda runtime. "rust" deploys a Rust function on the OS-only provided.al2023 runtime and requires entry.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds. Valid: 1 to 900. Default: 5.

tracing.description: Enable AWS X-Ray tracing. Incurs per-trace cost (~$5/million traces). Default: false.

url.description: Enable a direct HTTPS endpoint for the function. Auth mode is AWS_IAM - never public. Default: false.

vpc.description: Places the Lambda inside a VPC for access to private resources such as RDS or ElastiCache. Anvil creates a dedicated security group with zero inbound and zero outbound rules. Nothing is reachable until explicitly granted via the grant system.

arn.description: The ARN of the Lambda function.

functionName.description: The physical name of the Lambda function.

functionUrl.description: The HTTPS endpoint URL when url: true. Empty string if URL is not enabled.

roleArn.description: The ARN of the Lambda's IAM execution role.

securityGroupId.description: The ID of the dedicated security group created for this Lambda. Only populated when vpc is set. Use this to grant other resources access to this Lambda via the grant system.

enum.description: Intel/AMD - use for x86-specific native dependencies.

architectures.description: Instruction set architecture for your Lambda function.

code.description: Path to the function's deployment package within the local filesystem.

codeSha256.description: Base64-encoded representation the source code package file.

handler.description: Function entry point in your code.

kmsKeyArn.description: ARN of the AWS Key Management Service key used to encrypt environment variables.

layers.description: List of Lambda Layer Version ARNs (maximum of 5) to attach to your Lambda Function.

memorySize.description: Amount of memory in MB your Lambda Function can use at runtime.

name.description: Unique name for your Lambda Function.

reservedConcurrentExecutions.description: Amount of reserved concurrent executions for this lambda function.

sourceCodeHash.description: User-defined hash of the source code package file.

tags.description: Key-value map of tags for the Lambda function.

timeout.description: Amount of time your Lambda Function has to run in seconds.

tracingConfig.description: Configuration block for X-Ray tracing. See below.

vpcConfig.description: Configuration block for VPC. See below.

enum.description: 1 year (365 days) - SOC 2 / ISO 27001 / PCI-DSS baseline. Default.

architectures.description: Instruction set architecture for your Lambda function. Valid values are `["x86_64"]` and `["arm64"]`. Default is `["x86_64"]`. Removing this attribute, function's architecture stays the same.

capacityProviderConfig.description: Configuration block for Lambda Capacity Provider. See below.

code.description: Path to the function's deployment package within the local filesystem. Conflicts with `image_uri` and `s3_bucket`. One of `filename`, `image_uri`, or `s3_bucket` must be specified.

codeSha256.description: Base64-encoded representation the source code package file. Use this argument to trigger updates when the function source code changes. For OCI, this value is relayed directly from the image digest. For zip files, this value is the Base64 encoded SHA-256 hash of the `.zip` file. Layers are not included in the calculation. To trigger updates using a non-standard hashing algorithm, use the `source_code_hash` argument instead.

codeSigningConfigArn.description: ARN of a code-signing configuration to enable code signing for this function.

deadLetterConfig.description: Configuration block for dead letter queue. See below.

description.description: Description of what your Lambda Function does.

durableConfig.description: Configuration block for durable function settings. See below. `durable_config` may only be available in [limited regions](https://builder.aws.com/build/capabilities), including `us-east-2`.

environment.description: Configuration block for environment variables. See below.

ephemeralStorage.description: Amount of ephemeral storage (`/tmp`) to allocate for the Lambda Function. See below.

fileSystemConfig.description: Configuration block for EFS file system. See below.

handler.description: Function entry point in your code. Required if `package_type` is `Zip`.

imageConfig.description: Container image configuration values. See below.

imageUri.description: ECR image URI containing the function's deployment package. Conflicts with `filename` and `s3_bucket`. One of `filename`, `image_uri`, or `s3_bucket` must be specified.

kmsKeyArn.description: ARN of the AWS Key Management Service key used to encrypt environment variables. If not provided when environment variables are in use, AWS Lambda uses a default service key. If provided when environment variables are not in use, the AWS Lambda API does not save this configuration.

layers.description: List of Lambda Layer Version ARNs (maximum of 5) to attach to your Lambda Function.

loggingConfig.description: Configuration block for advanced logging settings. See below.

memorySize.description: Amount of memory in MB your Lambda Function can use at runtime. Valid value between 128 MB to 32,768 MB (32 GB), in 1 MB increments. Defaults to 128.

name.description: Unique name for your Lambda Function.

packageType.description: Lambda deployment package type. Valid values are `Zip` and `Image`. Defaults to `Zip`.

publish.description: Whether to publish creation/change as new Lambda Function Version. Defaults to `false`.

publishTo.description: Whether to publish to a alias or version number. Omit for regular version publishing. Option is `LATEST_PUBLISHED`.

region.description: Region where this resource will be [managed](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#regional-endpoints). Defaults to the Region set in the provider configuration.

replaceSecurityGroupsOnDestroy.description: Whether to replace the security groups on the function's VPC configuration prior to destruction. Default is `false`.

replacementSecurityGroupIds.description: List of security group IDs to assign to the function's VPC configuration prior to destruction. Required if `replace_security_groups_on_destroy` is `true`.

reservedConcurrentExecutions.description: Amount of reserved concurrent executions for this lambda function. A value of `0` disables lambda from being triggered and `-1` removes any concurrency limitations. Defaults to Unreserved Concurrency Limits `-1`.

role.description:
ARN of the function's execution role. The role provides the function's identity and access to AWS services and resources.

The following arguments are optional:

runtime.description: Identifier of the function's runtime. Required if `package_type` is `Zip`. See [Runtimes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/API_CreateFunction.html#SSS-CreateFunction-request-Runtime) for valid values.

s3Bucket.description: S3 bucket location containing the function's deployment package. Conflicts with `filename` and `image_uri`. One of `filename`, `image_uri`, or `s3_bucket` must be specified.

s3Key.description: S3 key of an object containing the function's deployment package. Required if `s3_bucket` is set.

s3ObjectVersion.description: Object version containing the function's deployment package. Conflicts with `filename` and `image_uri`.

skipDestroy.description: Whether to retain the old version of a previously deployed Lambda Layer. Default is `false`.

snapStart.description: Configuration block for snap start settings. See below.

sourceCodeHash.description: User-defined hash of the source code package file. Use this argument to trigger updates when the local function source code changes. This is a synthetic argument tracked only by the AWS provider and does not need to match the hashing algorithm used by Lambda to compute the `CodeSha256` response value. Out-of-band changes to the source code _will not_ be captured by this argument. To include out-of-band source code changes as an update trigger, use the `code_sha256` argument instead.

sourceKmsKeyArn.description: ARN of the AWS Key Management Service key used to encrypt the function's `.zip` deployment package. Conflicts with `image_uri`.

tags.description: Key-value map of tags for the Lambda function. If configured with a provider `default_tags` configuration block present, tags with matching keys will overwrite those defined at the provider-level.

tenancyConfig.description: Configuration block for Tenancy. See below.

timeout.description: Amount of time your Lambda Function has to run in seconds. Defaults to 3. Valid between 1 and 900.

tracingConfig.description: Configuration block for X-Ray tracing. See below.

vpcConfig.description: Configuration block for VPC. See below.

resource.description: ARN of the resource to grant access to. Accepts plain strings and Pulumi outputs.

enum.description: Rust on provided.al2023, built with cargo lambda. Requires entry.

cidrs.description: CIDR-scoped egress rules. One SG rule per port per CIDR. Use for peered VPCs or on-premise ranges.

hasNat.description: Only needed for imported VPCs with NAT. Omit when using an Anvil Vpc component.

privateSubnetIds.description: The IDs of the private subnets to attach the Lambda to. Always private - Lambda must never be placed in public subnets. Accepts Output<string[]> - pass vpc.privateSubnetIds directly.

vpcEndpoints.description: VPC endpoints this Lambda needs access to. Anvil wires both SG rules automatically.

vpcId.description: The ID of the VPC to place the Lambda in. Accepts Output<string> - pass vpc.vpcId directly.

ports.description: TCP ports to allow. Required - be explicit.

anvil:aws:LambdaVpcEndpointArgs.description: A VPC endpoint to grant this Lambda access to. Both fields accept Output<string> - pass component outputs directly.

endpointId.description: The endpoint's ID. Use ep.endpointId. Accepts Output<string>.

securityGroupId.description: The endpoint's security group ID. Use ep.securityGroupId. Accepts Output<string>.
